segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Mr. Grusch, in speaking to you yesterday, I just wanted to follow up on Representative Raskin's questions. In the last couple of years, have you had incidences that have caused you to be in fear for your life for addressing these issues?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Yes, Personally, I have.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: I just want everyone to note that he's coming forward in fear of his life. To put in perspective, if they were really not scared about this information coming out, why would someone be intimidated like that? To your knowledge, are <abbr title="Non-Human Intelligences">NHI</abbr> working with adversarial foreign governments in either technology exchange programs or back engineering programs?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I don't have data on that. I'm not sure.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Have you heard or you had people come forward to present that evidence?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Not that particular evidence that you just exposed.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Okay. On the 19 April, dr. Kirkpatrick, head of ADARO, had said that he did not find any evidence of UAPs. You also stated that you had -in your interview- that you had briefed him on information that you were uncovering, but that he did not follow up with you. Were the items that you divulged to him pertain to national security?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Yes. Him and I had a classified conversation in April 2022 before he took over ADARO in July 2022. And I provided him some concerns I had.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Do you know why he might not have followed up with you?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Unfortunately, I cannot read his mind. I wish he did. I was happy to give Sage counsel to him on where to look when he took the head of ADARO.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Okay. And then my last question for you before I move to Mr. Graves is you received prior approval from the Defense Department to speak on certain issues, correct?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Correct. Through DOPSR, DoD Prepublication and Security Review. And I just want to remind the public they're just looking from a security perspective. These are my own personal views and opinions, not the departments.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Okay. I'm asking that, though, mainly because I think that there are many people that would like to discredit you. So it does bring a certain amount of credibility to your testimony.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I'm required by law to do that as a former intelligence officer, or I go to jail for revealing classified information.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Yeah, we don't want you to go to jail. My next question would actually be for Mr. Graves. Can you please explain to me in detail the event that occurred at Vandenberg Air Force Base?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Certainly. In the 2003 time frame. A large group of Boeing contractors were operating near one of the launch facilities at Vandenberg Air Force Base when they observed a very large, 100 yard sided red square approach the base from the ocean and hover at low altitude over one of the launch facilities. This object remained for about 45 seconds or so before darting off over the mountains. There was a similar event within 24 hours later in the evening. This was a morning event, I believe 845 in the morning. Later in the evening, post sunset, there were reports of other sightings on base, including some aggressive behaviors. These objects were approaching some of the security guards at rapid speeds before darting off. And this is information that was received through one of the witnesses that have approached me at Americans for Safe Aerospace.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Was this documented in any official form, whether it was a police blotter?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Yes, they had official documentation and records from the event that the witness held over the years.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: And I'm not going to ask you to do it right now for time reasons, but you'd be able to sketch what was witnessed? And have you seen that before on any other equipment and or during your flight time?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I have not seen what they have described. This object was estimated to be almost a size of a football field, and I have not seen anything personally that large.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Okay. And then another question on follow up referencing the Gimbal video go Fast incident, can you just clarify? Because to our understanding, the footage was actually cut off at a certain point. But what happens at the end of that video just for those Americans specifically that are wanting to know about the rest of that footage?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Certainly there was some uncertainty or instability with the object. It seemed to rock a bit, and that's the last I had seen of the video. Much of the data that I would recommend be analyzed would consist of radar data that would provide precise kinematics on the object as well as the fleet of objects that were operating nearby.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Okay. And follow up in regards to the reporting procedures that Mr. Garcia had addressed on, as well as Representative Burchett with the FAA. To your understanding, pilots that are seeing this, commercial airline pilots, are they receiving cease and desist letters from corporations for coming forward with information in regards to safety for potential airline passengers?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I have been made privy to conversations with commercial aviators who have received cease and desist orders.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: So the American public should know that corporations are putting their own reputations on the basic, not the line, but ahead of the safety of the American people. And I think would you agree with that statement?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Appears so.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: I guess this would be my last... I'm out of time. I yield. I'll be back.
